_doc: TG/TL First-Tick system config. Copy to config.json. Every section documented inline. See docs/02_SYSTEM_DESIGN_AND_INTERFACES.md section 5.2 for the normative schema.

system._doc: Process-level settings. All schedule times elsewhere are interpreted in this timezone.

schedule._doc: Daily lifecycle. The service runs 24/7 under systemd and idles until phase1_time; there is nothing to launch manually.

broker._doc: Broker selection + order settings. data_broker (zerodha|upstox) supplies the feed, instrument master and quotes; trade_broker (zerodha|upstox|paper) places orders. They are INDEPENDENT -- data on upstox with trade_broker=paper touches no Zerodha key at all. product is per instrument class: stock options use NRML to avoid the MIS physical-settlement block; index options are cash-settled so MIS is fine. rate_limits mirror Kite's documented caps and are enforced locally.

trading_mode._doc: 'paper' places no broker orders and simulates fills at the touch. 'live' places real orders. Start with paper.

universe._doc: What to trade. candidate_buffer adds extra ranks either side of the cutoff: those chains are SUBSCRIBED but NOT traded, so a ranking shuffle near the open cannot leave us without a live chain. ranking_basis/atm_source use the 09:09 settlement price (options do not trade pre-open, so previous close is the option reference).

instruments._doc: Strike selection and subscription budgeting. expiry_roll: stock F&O is physically settled and Zerodha blocks fresh MIS buys in the last two trading days, so stocks roll to the next expiry; indices are cash-settled and never roll.

snapshots._doc: Reference captures. preopen_track records the whole equity auction continuously; settlement is the ranking and ATM basis; option_reference is the per-strike baseline for the diff trigger.

entry._doc: min_diff 0.0 means 'first strictly positive tick'. fire_after_seconds avoids 09:15:00.000 being treated as an AMO. deadline_seconds stops a mid-day restart from firing stale entries. order_type MUST stay LIMIT for stock options -- Zerodha blocks MARKET there; order_fallback rescues the order if you set MARKET anyway.

exits._doc: Evaluated in priority order; first trigger wins. Each condition is independently toggleable. When trailing_target is enabled, the plain TARGET exit is suppressed and the position exits at max_extension_pct or on pullback instead.

positions._doc: max_per_symbol 1 prevents pyramiding. broker_sync polls the positions API to detect positions closed manually in the Kite app (there is no position stream on the websocket).

recorder._doc: Full-depth tick capture from feed connect until the last position closes + post_exit_record_seconds. on_disk_full 'stop_recording' keeps trading and stops recording; 'halt_trading' does the opposite.

alerts._doc: Optional notifications. Leave disabled until you have a channel configured.

api._doc: Bind host to 127.0.0.1 when running behind Caddy (recommended) so the API is never directly exposed. cors_origins must list the exact frontend origins including Vercel preview hostnames. NEVER use '*' with a real auth_token.

paper._doc: Paper-mode simulation. fill_model 'touch' fills at the ask we observed, capped at our limit -- what a marketable limit really gets.
